title: app.act, surface protocol 1
description: The root validates the result of an accepted act. $defs/params is the request's params; $defs/refusal is the JSON-RPC error object a refused act answers with. Normative text: docs/surface-protocol.md.

action.description: The action's exact name, as describe lists it.

args.description: The arguments, by the names the action declares. Absent means none.

expect_revision.description: The revision the caller decided on. Checked in the same turn as the handler; a mismatch is refused with STALE:.

grant.description: The request_id a person's Allow turned into a grant. Spent through the shell once the ceiling has passed. Empty means none.

agent_token.description: The token of the agent the call is for. Beside args, never among them.

action_id.description: A name for this dispatch, unique within the surface's run: <service-id>#<n>.

accepted.description: Always true: the guard passed and the handler ran. Never read as done.

settled.description: Whether the work is finished (the action's settles is on return) or only started (later).

result.description: The handler's own answer, any JSON; null when withheld.

private.description: Present and true while the person has Private mode on: summary, state and revision are the private view.

withheld.description: Present in Private mode for a caller the kernel does not vouch for: why result is null.

code.description: -32602 for every refusal of the act itself (the dispatch's or the handler's); -32000 when the app did not answer; -32601 unknown method; -32700 a line that is not a request.
